vec.description: A foreign-issued Verifiable Endorsement Credential carrying the role grant, with its own eddsa-jcs-2022 proof (opaque here).

vmc.description: A foreign-issued Verifiable Membership Credential proving membership, optionally with credentialStatus for live revocation (opaque here).

sessionId.description: A cross-community session id (xc-<uuid>), distinguishing it from local-member sessions.

accessExpiresAt.description: Unix-seconds expiry, clamped to min(local default, earliest of the vec/vmc validUntil).

mappedRole.description: The LOCAL role from cross_community_roles policy — not the foreign role.
